title: IATA — Guidance Material and Best Practices for Aircraft Leases, 4.1 edition, December 2025
quote: The rental fee is most commonly paid monthly, in advance
finding: LOI precedes detailed lease negotiation; rent timing, security, maintenance reserves and redelivery conditions must be distinguished. Contracts may vary.

title: AerCap — Form 20-F for the year ended 31 December 2025
locator: Aircraft leasing, pp.30–31; Significant components of revenues and expenses, pp.46–47
quote: we receive the benefit, and assume the risks, of the residual value
finding: Lessor retains residual-value exposure, reviews lessee credit, manages transitions and sale timing; maintenance payments may reimburse events or compensate condition and are not all unconditional margin.
use: lessor economics, credit review, maintenance and residual risk

title: Air Lease Corporation — Form 10-K for the year ended 31 December 2025
locator: Interest Rate Risk, p.65; risk factors on borrowing costs, p.21
quote: Lease rates, and therefore our revenue from a lease, are generally fixed over the life of our leases.
finding: A lease is not mechanically repriced each month with CPI or funding costs. Forward delivery contracts can include interest-rate or manufacturer escalation adjusters; demand and supply also affect rent.
use: market rate versus modeled financing requirement

title: Lufthansa Group — Annual Report 2025, note on assets and leases
quote: The short-haul aircraft will be leased back for a period of 72 months
finding: A disclosed airline example of sale-and-leaseback with different maturities; no per-aircraft transaction price is inferred.
use: real transaction structure and differing lease tenors

title: IFRS Foundation — IFRS 16 Leases
quote: a lessee should recognise assets and liabilities arising from a lease
finding: Using an operating lease does not by itself mean the airline has no balance-sheet obligation; IFRS 16 includes right-of-use assets and lease liabilities, subject to its scope and exemptions.

title: Aviation Working Group — 2024 lease transfer documentation
quote: a set of lease transfer principles
finding: A sale of an aircraft can involve transfer or novation of the existing lease; transfer documentation is separate from the aircraft leaving airline service.
use: secondary aircraft sale and existing lease transfer

title: Avolon — Sale and leaseback of Boeing 787-9 with TAAG, 23 October 2025
quote: the agreement of a sale and leaseback for one new Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner aircraft
finding: A primary lessor announcement documents a new-aircraft sale-and-leaseback. A purchase price or rent is not disclosed and is not inferred.
